about: Proposal 0028, item 1: columns whose design specifications the engine writes among its MESH equations when it has a restart profile (src/units/columns/specifications.js, engine.js product_spec). Each case is solved by the independent reference validation/python/reference_mesh_specifications.py --mesh (its specifications among its own equations), and by the engine twice: cold (the outer loop) and from its own profile, perturbed (the MESH form); test/columns-specs-in-mesh.test.js. The values asked were chosen near columns solved at a given reflux ratio and distillate flow (2026-11-26), so that each column exists; they are not data.

engine_against_reference.why: The engine meets a design specification to a scaled residual of 1e-6 (src/units/columns/specifications.js, SPEC_TOLERANCE: for a purity x about 1e-6 x (1 - x), for a flow a relative 1e-6), the reference to 1e-12, so the two columns differ by the engine's tolerance on the specification times the column's sensitivity to it; these limits are about ten times the largest difference seen when the cases were written (2026-11-11).
